# developer.paypal.com documentation — Guides

> 5 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation under Guides. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Guides

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/guides/low-code-buy-button): The Buy Button is PayPal's low-code checkout experience.
- [Low-code buy button (/guides/low-code-buy-button)](https://developer.paypal.com/guides/low-code-buy-button.md): Accept PayPal payments with no backend. Generate a Buy Button in your PayPal dashboard and paste it straight into your site.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/guides/node-express): NodeJS
- [node-express.md](https://developer.paypal.com/guides/node-express.md)
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/guides/nextjs-checkout): Adding PayPal Checkout to a Next.js app used to require a fair amount of boilerplate. With the PayPal JavaScript SDK v6, the integration is more streamlined.
